public_posts.text: The ANC has broken South Africa's mining industry with decades of destructive policies that are hostile to investment.
The ANC-led coalition government in Nelson Mandela Bay Metro began the process of expropriating private land without compensation.
OUTA CEO Wayne Duvenage says that hte ANC deliberately appoints compromised individuals to state entities to weaken governance and create chaos.
South Africa is likely to receive a nasty Christmas gift from the United States: its removal from the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA).
South Africa must enshrine its reform process in law to guarantee the momentum gained under President Cyril Ramaphosa endures after he leaves office.

AfriForum said the widely cited claim that white South Africans own 72% of the country's land is misleading because it is based on incomplete, outdated data that excludes large categories of land ownership.

findings.quote: Cyril Ramaphosa has made South Africans poorer
findings.steelman_for: Headline summarises Colin Coleman's comparative growth claim that SA is poorer on a per-person basis under Ramaphosa.
findings.steelman_against: Declarative headline assigns personal blame for poverty without the caveats in the body (COVID, global shocks, coalition constraints).
findings.evidence_notes: Full body via curl. Opening: South Africans are materially worse off under President Cyril Ramaphosa.

findings.quote: Tide is turning against Ramaphosa and South Africa
findings.steelman_for: CRA warned impeachment reopen could interrupt the GNU/reform investment thesis; DI reports that risk.
findings.steelman_against: Headline universalises CRA view as fact that the tide is turning against both the person and the country.
findings.evidence_notes: Body cites Centre for Risk Analysis on Constitutional Court impeachment ruling. Driver recoded in CHG-MW-008 from selective_framing to framing to match the official closed driver set. Weight and signed_score are frozen (not rewritten).

findings.quote: Ramaphosa wins a major victory in impeachment battle
findings.steelman_for: Western Cape High Court did interdict parliamentary impeachment hearings — a clear procedural win.
findings.steelman_against: Major victory editorialises a temporary interdict that does not clear the underlying Phala Phala findings.
findings.evidence_notes: Bloomberg-syndicated straight court report; headline valence is DI framing. Driver recoded in CHG-MW-008 from outcome_credit to framing to match the official closed driver set. Weight and signed_score are frozen (not rewritten).

findings.quote: Ramaphosa backs new R100 billion Transformation Fund that can end BEE
findings.steelman_for: Ramaphosa did endorse the Transformation Fund in a parliamentary reply; some analysts see it as BEE reform.
findings.steelman_against: That can end BEE overclaims — fund alters BEE scoring, does not repeal BEE statutes.
findings.evidence_notes: Soft favourable framing of Ramaphosa as reformer on empowerment model. Driver recoded in CHG-MW-008 from selective_framing to framing to match the official closed driver set. Weight and signed_score are frozen (not rewritten).

findings.steelman_against: Headline pins the ANC nationally for a metro process and foregrounds EWC scare without balancing city legal defence.
